module sub_64bit ( 
   input [63:0] A ,  
   input [63:0] B ,  
   output reg [63:0] result ,  
   output reg overflow   
) ;

always @(*) begin
    result = A - B ;
end

always @(*) begin
    
    if ( (A[63] == 1'b1 && B[63] == 1'b0 && result[63] == 1'b0) || (A[63] == 1'b0 && B[63] == 1'b1 && result[63] == 1'b1) ) begin
        overflow = 1'b1 ;
    end else begin
        overflow = 1'b0 ;
    end
end

`timescale 1ns/1ps
module verified_counter_12 
(
  input rst_n,
  input clk,
  input valid_count,

  output reg [3:0] out
);

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) 
	begin
      out <= 4'b0000;
    end 

	else if (valid_count) 
	begin
      if (out == 4'd11) 
	  begin
        out <= 4'b0000;
      end 
	  else begin
        out <= out + 1;
      end
    end 
	
	else begin
      out <= out; // Pause the count when valid_count is invalid
    end
  end

endmodule
